name: multi-platform-releaser
description: Multi-forge publishing for local DSH plugins: tick any of GitHub / Gitee / Codeberg plus npm, fill the metadata once, then create every repository, push the same commit to each remote, tag, Release and npm publish from a single button. · 多代码平台发布插件：一键把本地 DSH 插件同时发布到 GitHub / Gitee / Codeberg / npm——同一个 commit 推到每个远端，各自建仓、各自发 Release；每个平台用自己账号的令牌，某个平台失败不影响其他平台。

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node tests/verify-static.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/host-sim.mjs && node tests/multi-platform.spec.mjs && node tests/readme-append.spec.mjs && node tests/version-sync.spec.mjs && node tests/npm-version-guard.spec.mjs && node tests/npm-name-scope.spec.mjs && node tests/lib-git.spec.mjs && node tests/providers.spec.mjs && node tests/lib-github.spec.mjs && node tests/client-smoke.mjs && node tests/client-ssr.check.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:e2e
